title: 5 Private En Suites | 2 Pools + Spa | 2 Acres
description:
Seven bedrooms. Five with their own private bathroom.

That is why groups who would otherwise book two houses, or four resort rooms, book this one instead. Nobody shares a sink. Nobody waits on a shower before a 7 AM tee time. Everyone gets their own door, and the group still wakes up in the same kitchen.

On 2.28 private acres near Pinnacle Peak. Single level, no stairs. Two saltwater pools, twelve person spa, theater, gazebo with pool table.
amenities: 65 inch HDTV with Apple TV, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated

Such a beautiful home and the perfect getaway! The pool was the highlight—large, clean, and absolutely gorgeous. The house was comfortable, well-kept, and had everything we needed. We had such a wonderful stay and would definitely come back!

This was hands down, my best rental experience over all the years! This house was perfect for the joint birthday celebration we had for our wives and my son and everyone enjoyed the amenities! Spacious, clean, kid and pet friendly, and the descriptions is exactly what you’ll get. I’ve saved this location to rent in the future because it’s everything we needed and more. Went back into work on Monday with intentions on working towards a place like this of our own in the future!

Joanna and Mark’s house is beautiful, and they are wonderful people. I am so grateful they welcomed us into their home; my whole family loved it. My children were happiest in the pool. Everything about the house is beautiful, and it is a very quiet, relaxing place. My siblings and I get together every year to visit our mom in Arizona, and this house is going to be our favorite spot—it’s the best. Thank you so Much for Everything!!
